_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (score moves ±2 in only ~7% of windows) plus live score inside 47-54 means phase stays put unless a breaker prints; tactical short is separate from phase direction.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on pressure (analyst SHORT + narrative distribution); analyst explicitly HOLDs phase, narrative silent on phase so no split on rung
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear_greed and 30d momentum stay ~45-55 through Friday OPEX while BTC fails to reclaim 82000
next_move.invalidated_if: Composite leaves 47-54 (fear_greed/momentum under 39 or over 63) or BTC holds above 82000 with ETF flows turning up
